questions.question: Reasoning Puzzle #111: In a seating alignment of 136 candidates facing North, Priya is ranked 11th from left. Simultaneously, a runner travels 225 km North, turns East 334 km, then South 225 km. What is Priya's rank from right and runner's net displacement?
questions.hint: Rank from right = Total (136) - Left (11) + 1 = 126th. North/South movements cancel, leaving 334 km East.
